findings: Validation feedback absent on first Submit — the inline validation message in ComposePane renders only when at least one field has been touched (title || body). A user who opens a fresh form and immediately clicks Post Announcement sees only the toast error; the in-form cue never appears. Add a submitted boolean to ComposePane and gate the message on !valid && (submitted || title || body).

urgent and info share the same SVG icon — both use the circle-with-exclamation glyph. A distinct icon (alert-octagon, siren) would make urgent announcements visually distinguishable in the list dots and type selector. Cosmetic, but inconsistent with the type color differentiation effort.
